scholarships.title: Undergraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
scholarships.funding_label: Tuition Fee Waiver (NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees)

existing.funding_period: one-off tuition fee contribution for one year of study
existing.description: Massey University's Undergraduate International Study Grants give new international students a NZ$15,000 contribution towards tuition fees for one year of full-time undergraduate study in a listed Bachelor's degree. Applicants are from any region but must be international students studying onshore in New Zealand. No separate application is made: the grant is assessed at the point of admission and appears on the offer of place if successful.
eligibility: Be an international student (the page's stated restriction is 'International Students. Full time study. Specific programmes only. Onshore study.')
Enrol full-time in one of the fifteen listed undergraduate degrees in 2027
Not hold a fully funded government scholarship such as Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki or TSLS
existing.eligibility_summary: New international students enrolling full-time at Massey University for the first time in 2027, in one of fifteen listed undergraduate degrees, studying onshore in New Zealand. Students holding a fully funded government scholarship (Fed Aid, SACM, Manaaki, TSLS or similar) are not eligible.
benefits: NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees, one year duration
coverage: NZ$15,000 towards tuition fees for one year. Living costs, accommodation and travel are not covered.
requirements: Full-time enrolment in an eligible programme
Meet all university admission requirements for the chosen degree
application_method: No separate scholarship application is made
Apply to study at Massey University
The University assesses the application for grant eligibility at the point of admission
If successful, the grant is displayed on the admission offer of place
existing.selection_notes: Not a competitive panel process: the grant is assessed at the point of admission and shown on the offer of place. Applicants whose degree is not on the eligible list are directed to the separate Toroa International Undergraduate Fee Scholarship.
existing.best_fit: International students applying for 2027 entry to one of the fifteen listed Massey undergraduate degrees who want an automatic tuition contribution rather than a separate scholarship application.
existing.notes: Awarded automatically on admission, not by a separate application. One year of funding only, so the remaining tuition for later years of the degree is not covered by this grant. A 2027 International Study Grants regulations PDF is linked from the page.
existing.application_period: Any intake in the 2027 academic year. The official page shows Status: Open as at 2026-10-04.
existing.deadline_display: No application deadline - the grant is assessed at the point of admission for any 2027 intake
